2026-11-12: Root cause (harness, not engine): _write_staging_file in benchbox/core/primitives/generator_base.py read SF1 staging rows through an Arrow CSV streaming reader over a zstd Python stream, stopped at the 1M-row limit while the reader's background thread was still reading, and closed the stream under it, corrupting the native heap (backtrace: zstandard backend_c <- PyObject_CallMethod <- arrow::py::PyReadableFile::Read). Fix in PR #4185: line-by-line staging copy with identical output, plus a regression test that the stream is read only from the calling thread and never after close. Linux: old code 300-iteration reproducer segfaults (139), fixed exits 0; duckdb write_primitives SF1 exit 0. SQLite SF1 local run killed 6x by the host memory watchdog; confirm on the next trunk UAT.
